title: Coding4Games: Can Modern Coding Agents Play Modern Video Games?
title_zh: Coding4Games：现代编程智能体能玩现代电子游戏吗？
abstract_en: Games, especially modern AAA games, challenge language models to perceive complex scenes, control actions, and make decisions over long horizons. Existing game benchmarks primarily test language models as computer-use agents that query a language model throughout play, incurring repeated inference cost and, in real-time games, acting while the environment continues to evolve. We ask whether coding agents can learn from game interaction to develop standalone game-playing programs that run without language model inference. We thus introduce Coding4Games, a benchmark for evaluating whether coding agents can develop standalone programs that play modern games through visual observations and standard game inputs. Coding4Games has three defining features: 1) Diverse Modern Games, covering 15 games with diverse visual, strategic, and control demands; 2) Development-Test Separation, in which a coding agent uses a sandbox and the standard player interface to iteratively develop a program, after which the selected program is frozen and independently tested without language-model inference; and 3) Outcome and Process Evaluation, which measures not only game performance and reliability but also how agents use feedback, revise programs, and resolve problems during development. Across 15 games, the best program per game outscores the strongest GUI baseline on 13 and ties it on one. The human player outscores all agents on 10 games. We additionally examine the effects of development budgets. Coding4Games evaluates whether coding agents can turn their understanding of complex interactive environments into programs that work reliably on their own.
abstract_zh: 现代电子游戏，尤其是 AAA 游戏，要求智能体理解复杂画面、精准操控，并在较长时间跨度内做出决策。现有游戏基准主要评估在游玩过程中反复调用语言模型的计算机操作智能体。这不仅带来持续的推理成本，在实时游戏中，环境还会在模型推理期间继续变化。Coding4Games 转而评估编程智能体能否通过与游戏交互，开发出仅凭视觉观测和标准游戏输入就能独立游玩的程序。该基准覆盖 15 款在视觉、策略和操控方面各有挑战的现代游戏，并将开发与测试分离：智能体在沙箱中通过标准玩家界面迭代开发，选定的程序随后被冻结，在不调用语言模型的条件下独立测试。评估既考察程序的游戏表现和可靠性，也分析智能体如何利用反馈、修改程序和解决问题。逐游戏选取的最佳程序在 13 款游戏中得分超过最强 GUI 基线，在 1 款中持平；人类玩家在 10 款游戏中得分高于所有智能体。论文还考察了开发预算对表现的影响。
key_points_zh: Coding4Games 将评估重点从语言模型实时操作游戏，转为编程智能体能否写出独立运行的游戏程序。
基准覆盖 15 款现代游戏；开发阶段允许在沙箱中交互迭代，测试阶段冻结程序，不调用语言模型。
评估兼顾游戏得分、运行可靠性与开发过程，并考察开发预算的影响。
逐游戏选取的最佳程序对最强 GUI 基线取得 13 胜 1 平；人类玩家仍在 10 款游戏中得分高于所有智能体。
